seo.description: Registry information for Jeff and Paige's wedding.
seo.social_description: Your presence is the greatest gift.

hero.label: Gifts & Wishes
hero.title: Registry
hero.subtitle: Your presence at our wedding is the greatest gift of all.

intro.label: With Gratitude
intro.title: A Little from the Heart
intro.text: The best part of our wedding day will be celebrating it with you, so please don't feel you need to bring a gift. If you'd like to give one anyway, everything you need is right here.

coming_soon.label: Coming Soon
coming_soon.title: Our registry is on its way
coming_soon.text: We'll set it up in 2027 and share the link right here. Check back closer to the day.

amazon.title: Amazon Wedding Registry
amazon.text: It includes gifts from other stores too, and Amazon shows what's already been bought so nothing doubles up.

cash_fund.title: Honeymoon & Home Fund
cash_fund.text: If you'd rather give toward our first trip or our first home, we'd be grateful for any contribution.

shipping_note.label: A Small Request
shipping_note.title: Please Ship, Don't Carry
shipping_note.text: We'd love it if you skipped bringing boxed gifts to the venue, since we won't have a safe place to keep them that night. Anything from our registry ships straight to us.
